metadata.description: Final evaluation of 100k-step PPO residual RL training on V13.7 FSM controller
metadata.data_source: README.md line 209, 226-227. Training completed by Codex on 2026-06-09.
metadata.note: Based on documented claims in README.md. Results from 100k PPO sanity training evaluation.

residual_action_space.description: Hip joint residual torques only (knee fixed to FSM output)

baseline_performance.description: V13.7 FSM controller with zero residual (identity test)
baseline_performance.note: Baseline validated before training to ensure environment correctness

sweep_results.description: Pre-training sweep to find optimal residual direction

improvement_over_baseline.interpretation: Consistent improvement, though below sweep peak (7.39%)

performance_comparison.note: Trained policy achieves 79% of sweep peak improvement (5.79/7.39)

key_findings.1_baseline_validation: Zero residual identity test confirms V13.7 baseline at 4.630m with 100% success
key_findings.2_residual_direction_matters: Sweep found optimal direction: positive residual on both hip joints ([0.1, 0.2]Nm)
key_findings.3_rl_learning_success: PPO successfully learned residual policy improving performance by 5.79%
key_findings.4_consistent_stability: 100% success rate maintained across all evaluations (no regressions)
key_findings.5_room_for_improvement: Trained policy at 79% of sweep peak suggests further tuning potential

next_steps.longer_training: Scale to 500k-1M steps to approach sweep peak performance
next_steps.hyperparameter_tuning: Optimize PPO hyperparameters (learning rate, entropy coefficient)
next_steps.reward_shaping: Refine reward function to better capture desired behavior
next_steps.domain_randomization: Add parameter noise to improve robustness

reporting_guidance.classification: Reinforcement learning optimization layer on quasi-passive V13.7 controller
reporting_guidance.honest_representation: 5.79% improvement is modest but consistent - report as proof-of-concept success
reporting_guidance.comparison_context: Improvement is relative to already-stable V13.7 baseline, not a fix for instability
reporting_guidance.academic_integrity: This is RL-assisted control, not pure RL or pure passive walking
